title: From the city to the village
situation: Your family has recently moved from a flat in the city to a house in a small village. You have received this e-mail from your English friend, Liam. Write a reply to him.
situationHu: A családod nemrég városi lakásból egy falusi házba költözött; válaszolj angol barátod, Liam e-mailjére.
stimulus:
Hi,
Your mum told my mum that you've moved house – is it true? I can't believe you didn't tell me! Why did you move? Do you like living in a village? And how are you getting on with your little brother now that you have to share a room? Tell me everything!
Liam

points.text: explain why your family decided to move
compare your life in the village with your life in the city
describe how sharing a room has affected your relationship with your brother

usefulPhrases.en: Sorry I didn't tell you earlier – it all happened so fast.
usefulPhrases.hu: Bocs, hogy nem szóltam korábban – minden olyan gyorsan történt.

usefulPhrases.en: My parents had been thinking about moving for ages.
usefulPhrases.hu: A szüleim már régóta gondolkodtak a költözésen.

usefulPhrases.en: We needed more space and a garden.
usefulPhrases.hu: Több helyre és kertre volt szükségünk.

usefulPhrases.en: Compared to the city, the village is much quieter.
usefulPhrases.hu: A városhoz képest a falu sokkal csendesebb.

usefulPhrases.en: The downside is that it takes me an hour to get to school.
usefulPhrases.hu: A hátránya, hogy egy órába telik beérni az iskolába.

usefulPhrases.en: We get on each other's nerves.
Anyway, that's enough about me. How are things with you?
usefulPhrases.hu: Na de elég rólam. Veled mi újság?

checklistExtra: Az összehasonlításnál használtam középfokot és ellentétes kötőszavakat (whereas, while, compared to)?

modelAnswer.text:
Hi Liam,

Sorry I didn't tell you earlier – it all happened so fast! My parents had been thinking about moving for ages because they were tired of the city noise, so when Dad got a job in Gödöllő, they bought a house in a nearby village.

Compared to the city, the village is much quieter and the air is far cleaner. Whereas I used to go to the cinema with friends after school, now I mostly go cycling. The downside is that it takes me an hour to get to school.

As for sharing a room with my little brother, at first we got on each other's nerves, especially when he played games late at night. On the bright side, we've become much closer – we even built a treehouse together last weekend!

How are things with you?

All the best,
Máté

pointsCovered.quote: My parents had been thinking about moving for ages because they were tired of the city noise, so when Dad got a job in Gödöllő, they bought a house in a nearby village.
Whereas I used to go to the cinema with friends after school, now I mostly go cycling.
On the bright side, we've become much closer – we even built a treehouse together last weekend!

notes: Feladat teljesítése: Liam mindhárom kérdésére érdemi válasz érkezik – a költözés két oka, összehasonlítás a városi élettel (előnyök és egy hátrány), végül a közös szoba hatása a testvérkapcsolatra, kezdeti nehézséggel és pozitív fordulattal.
Hangnem: baráti e-mail – bocsánatkérés a kezdetén (Sorry I didn't tell you earlier), összevont alakok, visszakérdezés és All the best a végén; pontosan reagál Liam szemrehányására.
Szövegalkotás: az összehasonlítást középfok és ellentétes kötőszavak teszik világossá (Compared to the city, much quieter, far cleaner, Whereas …, The downside is that …, On the bright side, …).

Nyelvhelyesség és szókincs: a past perfect continuous (had been thinking about moving for ages) és a used to (Whereas I used to …) pontos; érdemes megtanulni: get on each other's nerves, it takes me an hour to get to school.
